entries.338ac6f405d639cd: The company states that it has set as its purpose 'Unleash the power of finance' and as its mission 'Ethics in finance, freedom in life,' positions itself as a 'Financial Partner,' develops financial services without being bound by any single business format, and aims to provide the best services for customers, with the quality of its consulting process for realizing life plans and the provision of financial knowledge and information that improves customers' financial literacy as the source of its value.

entries.925945a3c0671ef2: Built on life planning, a business that advises individual customers on asset building and funding plans, and sells and brokers financial products such as life insurance, non-life insurance, securities and housing loans, as well as real estate.
